summary: Armour Residential REIT filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, announcing a regular monthly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share for June 2026, with a holder-of-record date of June 15 and payment on June 29. The filing is a routine REIT dividend declaration to maintain tax-advantaged status under REIT rules; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring is present. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation.
